I'm serious here. I'm a chronic clusterhead and nobody understands what I go through.

What happens? How can I recognize it? What can I do (if anything).
This sub seems pretty dead but can you subscribers describe clinical depression to us? What happens? I'm not trolling, I'd truly like to understand.

Well I've had severe medicated depression for about eight years now, doctors have discussed an implant and I've bounced in and out of the crazy house a few times. So at this stage I can give a pretty decent description, but bear in mind that all depressions are subtly different in the myriad ways they appear, there are just some unifying themes that I'll describe here.

Depression hits you after a sustained chemical imbalance has reduced your bodies release of the happy chemicals, serotonin and dopamine, this can be a long term negative outlook on life and lack of positive stimulus or it could be from a trauma and the recovery like having a relative die and not being able to adjust to their loss. Sometimes it can be as a result of head trauma after an accident like a car crash or a lightning strike.

You can pretty easily spot a depressed person because they can't sustain happiness, if you make them laugh the smile will fade quickly unless you keep them upbeat. They often can't remember the last time they felt actual joy, because the memories of such events are muted without a squirt of happy chemicals to link them to the past good time.

You can tell that you yourself are depressed by doing something positive, like having sex or building something or achieving some personal goal, and gauging how you feel afterwards. Depressed people tend to feel a lack of emotion, an empty feeling, because they don't feel bad about what they did but they physically can't feel good about it either, so they get a null response. This can in long term depression become a thorn to some people, as doing something positive leads to this empty feeling and they desperately want to feel something so the brain just makes them feel bad about it, at least they feel something.

A good way of keeping depression at bay is to sustain a lifestyle that has good releases of happy chemicals from time to time, not so much you burn out but not so little your brain gears down and get's depressed. Have sex, run around, eat chocolate, achieve things in life. Hit enough of these points often enough and you'll prevent your brain from partially shutting down your monomine neurotransmitters.

A bad way to treat depression is to use illegal or unregulated drugs that force your brain to throw out dopamine or suppress it's ability to reabsorb it when it does. These can provide relief to even the most severe depression sufferers but the damage done to your brain's ability to produce dopamine is permanent and devastating so you have to keep upping the dose to keep the high going, all the while your brain is getting used to the size of the rush so it feels worse each time. It can lead to what is likely the worst imaginable state of being for a sentient creature: A permanent inability to feel good about anything and an inability to assign value to positive actions and positive memories. At this stage synthetic dopamine might be an option but likely the person will just kill themselves in a short time unless sedated and restrained.

My personal experience with depression is apathy and a lack of complete motivation. What helps me is distracting myself and focusing on the future, leaving my past behind, you can never change the past.

Obstacles are everywhere. Try to strengthen willpower more than looking for motivation, motivation is harder to find.

First off, let's all make sure we are looking at the evidence objectively. If there is no evidence that something happened, then it would be impossible to objectively claim that such a something had happened. No evidence means no proof.

Red Cross Document shows 271,301 dead jews, so I was misremembering that figure, but not by much. This document shows the total recorded deaths that occurred in concentration camps. There were probably unrecorded deaths, but if the deaths went unrecorded and there is no physical evidence of said deaths, then there obviously is no proof of them. If there is no evidence, then any claims made about such deaths would have little to no basis and are therefore fit for dismissal.

The change in the total deaths which occurred in Auschwitz can be illustrated most efficiently by the comparison of two different plaques located at the Auschwitz camp. The first plaque, placed there by The Soviet Union immediately after the end of WWII, made a claim that 4 million Jews were killed in Auschwitz. The second plaque, which was placed after the fall of the Soviet Union, claimed that 1.5 million Jews were killed there. But, according to the Auschwitz Museum, the total number of Jewish deaths that occurred in Auschwitz was closer to 1 million (this is an archived page, linked to as a reference [#200] on wikipedia, just fyi). So this is a drop from 4 million to 1 million, a reduction of 3 million.

According to the World Almanac printed in 1933, there were 15,315,359 Jews living on the planet Earth. According to the World Almanac printed in 1948, there were 15,753,638 living on Earth. (full disclosure: the only image I can find of this right now does not have a visible date) So, why aren't the 6 million Jews who were allegedly murdered in the Holocaust reflected by these figures?

Because I'm an accuracy freak, I have just purchased through Ebay World Almanacs from 1932, 1935, 1937, 1947, 1948, and 1952. I will see about posting my findings, in a new thread, from these volumes once they are delivered and I have time to sift through them.

Now, for the forensic analysis that demostrated that the alleged gas chambers were not actually gas chambers. If you have the patience and interest, you can read the whole Leuchter Report here. But if you don't feel like devoting the time, I will try to make it easy for you. In section 3.4, starting on page 26 (27 of the pdf) the following Synopsis and Findings is provided:

After a study of the available literature, examination and evaluation of the existing facilities at Auschwitz, Birkenau and Majdanek, with expert knowledge of the design criteria for gas chamber operation, an investigation of crematory technology and an inspection of modern crematories, the author finds no evidence that any of the facilities normally alleged to be execution gas chambers were ever used as such, and finds, further, that because of the design and fabrication of these facilities, they could not have been utilized for execution gas chambers.

Additionally, an evaluation of the crematory facilities produces conclusive evidence that contradicts the alleged volume of corpses cremated in the generally alleged time frame. It is therefore, the best engineering opinion of the author that none of the facilities examined were ever utilized for the execution of human beings and that the crematories could never have supported the alleged work load attributed to them.

I encourage you to continue reading beyond that section as it goes into greater detail how these findings were established. It gets a little technical, but that's forensic evidence for ya, technical.

I also encourage you to watch this documentary in which it is demonstrated on film that the alleged gas chamber at Auschwitz could have never functioned as a gas chamber for the mass extermination of Jews, or any humans.
